rationale: Calculated fault currents using Thevenin equivalent including source, transformer, and feeder impedances. Breaker rating selected as smallest standard rating exceeding max_3ph fault current with 1.1 safety factor. Relay pickup set to load margin minimum (360 * 1.25 = 450 A), which is within fault sensitivity constraint (1.5081 kA / 2.0 = 754.05 A).
